props.name: controlAs

props.name: nextText
props.description: Text to display in the next button.

props.name: prevText
props.description: Text to display in the previous button.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the root `<nav>` element.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Whether to show previous and next control buttons.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description:
Number of page buttons to show on either side of the current page.
Finite integer values are clamped between 0 and 100.

props.name: to
props.description:
Function to generate a destination URL for a given page number.
Without a custom component, enabled pagination controls with a destination render as anchors.

props.name: total
props.description: Total number of items across all pages.

props.name: prevIcon

props.name: defaultPage
